kind: functional (offline, real hosted row shape); hosted verification is owned by the sole Devpublisher task
root_cause: EVIDENCE-OWNER-LIST-BOUNDED-20261104 changed GET /bff/management/evidence to read one bounded 20-row owner page (returning page_info.total = 518 on hosted tenant-dev after excluding 96 legacy tenantless rows), but _management_evidence_summary in services/control-plane/bff/management_read_models/service.py continued computing verified_count, verified_evidence, by_source_type, by_link_type, and by_credibility_tier from page_items (the 20 rows on the current page), causing the UI summary to report 總數 518 alongside 已驗證 20.

design_summary.owner_models: Added EVIDENCE_VERIFIED_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.8 and summarize_evidence_items_collection in services/knowledge/evidence/models.py so EvidenceItem and BFF evidence ref collections share one canonical population summary aggregation.
design_summary.owner_repositories: Added summarize_evidence_items(tenant_id=...) to InMemoryEvidenceRepository (services/knowledge/evidence/repository.py) and PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository (services/source_ingestion/pg_store.py). The Postgres implementation executes one bounded GROUP BY SQL query with the exact same WHERE record_type = 'evidence_item' AND payload->'metadata'->>'tenant_id' = %s scope filter as list_evidence_items_page, excluding tenantless and foreign-tenant rows without materializing full rows.
design_summary.owner_route: Updated GET /api/source-ingest/evidence/items in services/source_ingestion/routers/ingest_operations.py to return 'summary' alongside 'items', 'total', 'page_size', and 'next_page_token' in one bounded owner response. If summarize_evidence_items fails while list_evidence_items_page succeeds, 'summary' is null while 'items' and 'total' remain intact.
design_summary.bff_port_and_service: Extended EvidenceReadResult with summary and summary_unavailable in services/control-plane/bff/ports/research_knowledge_source.py, and updated _management_evidence_summary and ManagementService.get_evidence in services/control-plane/bff/management_read_models/service.py to populate verified_count, verified_evidence, by_source_type, by_link_type, and by_credibility_tier from the tenant population summary (or null when the owner count read fails, never a page-sized number).

acceptance_map.1_tenant_population_summary_identical_ac: verified_count, verified_evidence, by_source_type, by_link_type, and by_credibility_tier in GET /bff/management/evidence describe the whole tenant population and are identical on page 1 (page_token=0, page_size=20) and page 2 (page_token=20, page_size=20); covered by test_management_evidence_summary_covers_whole_tenant_population_across_pages_with_one_bounded_read and test_evidence_items_route_returns_tenant_population_summary_and_excludes_tenantless_rows.
acceptance_map.2_single_bounded_owner_read_500_plus_rea: GET /bff/management/evidence issues exactly 1 bounded owner request per page call against a 518-row tenant-dev population (630 total rows in repo) with real hosted tw_price_daily/TWSE/0050 row shape; covered by test_management_evidence_summary_covers_whole_tenant_population_across_pages_with_one_bounded_read and test_unfiltered_management_page_does_not_download_every_owner_row.
acceptance_map.3_tenantless_rows_excluded_reconciling_h: 96 legacy rows without metadata.tenant_id and foreign-tenant rows stay excluded from both list total and summary counts in InMemoryEvidenceRepository, GET /api/source-ingest/evidence/items, and PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository.summarize_evidence_items so tenant-dev counts reconcile to 518; covered by test_management_evidence_summary_covers_whole_tenant_population_across_pages_with_one_bounded_read, test_postgres_owner_summarize_evidence_items_aggregates_in_sql_and_excludes_tenantless_rows, and test_evidence_items_route_returns_tenant_population_summary_and_excludes_tenantless_rows.
acceptance_map.4_null_on_owner_count_failure_preserving: When the owner count/summary read fails while the bounded list read succeeds, verified_count, verified_evidence, by_source_type, by_link_type, and by_credibility_tier are null (never a page-sized 20) while page_info.total and summary.total_evidence/total_items remain 518; when the entire owner read fails, all summary fields are null; covered by test_owner_count_failure_returns_null_summary_fields_and_preserves_bounded_list_total and test_owner_failure_reports_unavailable_with_null_totals.
acceptance_map.5_no_test_weakened_and_changed_fixtures_: No existing test or assertion was weakened or deleted. Mock owner fixtures in test_evidence_owner_list_bounded.py, test_ranking_evidence_surfaces_default_composition.py, and test_pm12_request_scoped_reads.py were updated to include the owner summary envelope (and the dict response for /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=persona_binding_counts).
